title: Boot registry seal
requirement: The kernel shall register application threads only before start, within a configured finite capacity, using permanent caller-provided control blocks and stacks.
acceptance_criteria: Exactly RTOS_MAX_THREADS unique registrations succeed; duplicate, excess and post-start calls fail unchanged; zero application threads starts idle.
verification: Host capacity/duplicate tests and target registration API/seal tests.
configuration: RTOS_MAX_THREADS 1..255.
resource_budget: Configured application pointer table plus one private idle thread.

title: Static resource lifetimes
requirement: The kernel shall retain boot resource ownership metadata through shutdown and neither allocate nor free general heap storage during initialization or execution.
acceptance_criteria: Firmware passes no-heap audit; repeated completion, IPC, timer and network operations preserve capacities and storage addresses; finished storage stays reserved.
verification: ELF audit, ownership review and target resource-inventory stress.
configuration: All enabled features.
resource_budget: Zero general heap bytes; boot-fixed capacities.

title: Stack registration bounds
requirement: Registration shall reject invalid stack alignment, insufficient size, address overflow and stack/control-block overlap before changing state.
acceptance_criteria: Reject size below 512, size/alignment not divisible by 16, overflowing ranges and overlap; accept touching ranges; failures preserve registry/control contents.
verification: Host boundary tests and target registration failure atomicity.
configuration: Minimum 512 bytes; alignment 16.
resource_budget: One scan of configured registered ranges.

title: Strict priority dispatch
requirement: At each dispatch the scheduler shall select the ready application thread with greatest effective priority and use idle only when no application is ready.
acceptance_criteria: Finite reference-model comparison never selects a lower ready priority; priority-zero work precedes idle; higher-priority wakeup wins next dispatch.
verification: Host small-state model and target wakeup/idle tests.
configuration: Priorities 0..255; larger first.
resource_budget: At most RTOS_MAX_THREADS candidates per selection.

title: Equal-priority fairness
requirement: Timer round robin shall rotate equal-priority ready peers when enabled; explicit yield shall rotate peers in either configuration.
acceptance_criteria: N ready peers each run once in N rotations; slicing disabled retains current peer unless higher priority ready; yield rotates in both modes.
verification: Peer counts, cursor wrap, blocked peers and target timer slicing tests.
configuration: RTOS_ROUND_ROBIN = 0 or 1.
resource_budget: Existing registry and one cursor; no extra allocations.

title: Priority changes
requirement: The priority API shall atomically update a registered live thread base priority and reconsider scheduling before returning when running while preserving active inheritance.
acceptance_criteria: Unregistered/finished fail unchanged; boot/sleeping changes succeed; lowering current permits higher-priority peer before return; preserve donations.
verification: Target priority changes, invalid IDs, sleeping and donated-priority cases.
configuration: Base/effective priorities 0..255.
resource_budget: Recomputation bounded by thread/mutex capacities.

title: Integer context preservation
requirement: The RISCue trap boundary shall preserve interrupted integer registers, continuation PC, stack pointer and machine status across preemption and yields with 16-byte C++ call alignment.
acceptance_criteria: Distinct register patterns survive 100000 timer preemptions and yields with zero PC, stack, register or interrupt-state mismatches.
verification: Assembly-assisted target register stress with nested C++ calls and canaries.
configuration: Single-hart RV32 integer machine mode; no FP/vector.
resource_budget: 144-byte frame plus analyzed kernel call depth.

title: Inline assembly compiler contracts
requirement: CSR and critical-section inline assembly shall declare correct operands and ordering; standalone assembly shall be limited to startup and asynchronous entry/restore.
acceptance_criteria: Every supported optimized configuration preserves context/API results; disassembly retains approved CSR operands and ordering.
verification: Compiler/disassembly review and target optimization/LTO matrix when supported.
configuration: Documented optimization/compiler configurations.
resource_budget: No new runtime storage; fixed assembly boundaries.

title: Relative sleep wrap semantics
requirement: Relative sleep shall accept 0..INT32_MAX ticks, treat zero as yield, reject larger delays and use wrap-safe deadlines.
acceptance_criteria: Cover 0, 1, INT32_MAX, INT32_MAX+1 and wrap across UINT32_MAX; rejected calls do not block or mutate state.
verification: Host modular arithmetic and target sleep API boundary tests.
configuration: 32-bit ticks; relative delay at most INT32_MAX.
resource_budget: One deadline/thread; one bounded wake scan.

title: Delayed timer catch-up
requirement: Timer handling shall compute missed periods arithmetically, scan sleepers once per delivered interrupt and reject catch-up beyond the modular horizon.
acceptance_criteria: 1, 10, 1000000 missed periods require one scan with model-equivalent wakes; greater than INT32_MAX invokes fault policy.
verification: Scan-count instrumentation and masked-interrupt/exact-boundary/horizon target tests.
configuration: Nonzero integer timer period; half-range horizon.
resource_budget: One arithmetic catch-up and one thread scan.

title: Timer MMIO integrity
requirement: The timer port shall read a coherent 64-bit monotonic clock and update compare without exposing a transient earlier deadline.
acceptance_criteria: Rollover reads are coherent; compare writes high-max, low, final-high; diagnostics report actual integer period.
verification: Instrumented MMIO and target rollover/write-order tests.
configuration: Timer/compare addresses and supplied clock/tick rates.
resource_budget: Three compare writes; read retry assumptions documented for hardware.

title: Absolute periodic release
requirement: The kernel shall provide absolute sleep and a static periodic helper advancing from prior intended deadlines with missed-release reporting.
acceptance_criteria: Variable work preserves original release grid; overdue activity skips to next future release and counts misses; reject zero/half-range-invalid periods; support wrap.
verification: On-time, missed-release, wrap and invalid-period tests.
configuration: Optional helper; period 1..INT32_MAX; saturating miss counter.
resource_budget: Fixed state per boot-created periodic activity.

title: Interrupt-state restoration
requirement: Kernel-private critical sections shall preserve prior interrupt state across internal scheduler transitions; while scheduling is active, public blocking or scheduling calls shall reject application-disabled interrupt context before changing thread state.
acceptance_criteria: Nested private locks restore prior MIE without enabling early. Internal sleep/resume preserves its private lock state. Application-held interrupt masking followed by sleep, yield, exit or a rescheduling priority change is rejected through a documented error or fault without a partial state transition; pre-start boot configuration remains legal.
verification: Target nested-lock/blocking/preemption MIE observation.
configuration: Single hart; no implicit interrupt nesting.
resource_budget: One saved status word per lock; nesting bounded by reviewed call depth.

title: Interrupt dispatcher boundary
requirement: The port shall dispatch registered supported sources, acknowledge through a board contract and route unsupported sources/exceptions to bounded fault handling.
acceptance_criteria: One handler/source; invalid/spurious IDs cannot call arbitrary memory or loop indefinitely; acknowledgment permits subsequent interrupts.
verification: External, invalid, spurious, disabled and repeated acknowledgment tests.
configuration: Fixed boot source capacity and board acknowledgment operations.
resource_budget: Fixed source table and bounded handling/acknowledgment.

title: Deferred interrupt work
requirement: Drivers shall signal boot-created deferred workers through explicit ISR APIs with fixed storage and bounded nonblocking operations.
acceptance_criteria: No ISR allocation/wait; full capacity returns result and increments overflow; accepted work wakes worker without lost signals.
verification: Burst, full, coalescing, wakeup and forbidden blocking-context tests.
configuration: Optional worker count, queue capacity and coalescing policy.
resource_budget: Boot worker stacks and fixed pending-work slots.

title: Static mutex ownership
requirement: Boot-initialized mutexes shall enforce a single owner, reject non-owner unlock and provide nonrecursive try, timed and blocking acquisition.
acceptance_criteria: One owner maximum; recursive acquisition reports error; timeout/unlock races preserve ownership; invalid/ISR/pre-start calls leave state consistent.
verification: Contention, recursion, wrong-owner, timeout-race and context-misuse tests.
configuration: Optional fixed mutex capacity; nonrecursive initially.
resource_budget: One owner/control record per mutex; bounded thread waiters.

title: Transitive priority inheritance
requirement: Mutex contention shall raise effective priorities to active donation maxima, propagate through bounded chains and recompute when donations end.
acceptance_criteria: H/L contention preempts M; H/L/X propagation works; timeout, unlock and base-priority changes recompute every held mutex without stale donations.
verification: H/M/L, chained, multiple-owner, withdrawal and base-priority change tests.
configuration: Mutex inheritance with priorities 0..255.
resource_budget: Traversal bounded by thread/mutex capacities; static graph storage.

title: Mutex deadlock and owner termination
requirement: Mutex acquisition shall detect wait-for cycles before blocking, and owner exit shall fault deterministically without silently releasing ownership.
acceptance_criteria: Two/three-thread cycles return deadlock; maximum-depth search terminates; owner return/exit records fault without ownership transfer.
verification: Cycle, maximum-chain and owner-return/exit fault tests.
configuration: Documented deadlock error and owner-exit fault policy.
resource_budget: At most RTOS_MAX_THREADS search nodes; fixed fault storage.

title: Counting and binary semaphores
requirement: Static semaphores shall enforce maximum count and offer try, timed, blocking take and bounded thread/ISR release with overflow results.
acceptance_criteria: Count within 0..max; overflow fails; timeout/release resolves exactly once; priority waiters and ISR rescheduling follow policy.
verification: Zero/max/overflow, waiter ordering, timeout-race and ISR tests.
configuration: Optional boot counts/max; binary maximum 1.
resource_budget: Fixed records and one wait membership/thread.

title: Atomic bounded wait lifecycle
requirement: Blocking primitives shall atomically register waiters, transition state and resolve wakeup, timeout or cancellation exactly once in fixed waiter storage.
acceptance_criteria: Signal-before/after-enqueue and timeout ties resolve once; no duplicate memberships; capacity never exceeds thread count.
verification: Deterministic scheduling/reference interleavings and repeated reuse.
configuration: Shared substrate for all blocking features.
resource_budget: One active wait record/thread; bounded object wait queues.

title: Event flags semantics
requirement: Enabled event groups shall support a configured width of 1..32 bits, a boot-declared reserved-bit mask, any/all waits, and optional clear-on-exit evaluated in descending effective priority with FIFO ordering among equal-priority waiters.
acceptance_criteria: Reject masks outside the configured width or containing reserved bits. Process waiters in priority/FIFO order against the remaining flags. For a satisfied clear-on-exit waiter, consume requested bits currently set (any) or all requested bits (all) before evaluating the next waiter; nonclearing waiters leave flags unchanged. Exhaustive 3-bit models cover consumption, simultaneous waiters and timeout/ISR-set races.
verification: Small-width exhaustive combinations, multiwaiter, timeout and ISR-set tests.
configuration: RTOS_EVENT_BITS = 1..32; boot reserved mask; priority/FIFO waiter order; explicit clear-on-exit.
resource_budget: Fixed flag/control record per group; bounded thread waiters.

title: Typed fixed-capacity queues
requirement: Queues shall hold a compile-time bounded number of trivially copyable messages in caller storage with FIFO send/receive and full, empty, timeout results.
acceptance_criteria: Capacity N accepts exactly N pending messages; FIFO survives wrap/multiple producers/consumers; rejected sends preserve data; invalid types/sizes/alignment fail compilation.
verification: Capacity 1/N, wrap, full/empty, concurrency, payload and compile-fail tests.
configuration: Optional payload type and positive static capacity.
resource_budget: N times payload bytes plus fixed metadata and bounded waiters.

title: ISR-safe queue subset
requirement: ISR queues shall use explicit nonblocking APIs, bounded copies, immediate capacity errors and interrupt-return higher-priority rescheduling.
acceptance_criteria: Maximum copy bounded; failed full/empty leaves state intact; accepted messages survive IRQ/consumer races; highest-ready worker runs next legal return.
verification: Maximum-payload, full/empty, interleaving, scheduling and misuse tests.
configuration: Explicit ISR subset and maximum payload bytes.
resource_budget: One configured bounded payload copy and fixed metadata changes.

title: Static software timers
requirement: Software timers shall use boot-reserved records, one-shot/periodic modes, bounded expiration processing and boot-created callback workers outside ISR.
acceptance_criteria: Capacity exhaustion returns an error. Periodic timers retain the intended release grid and allow at most one pending invocation per timer; excess expirations coalesce and increment a saturating 32-bit unsigned missed-expiration counter. Cancellation of a queued but not executing callback prevents its start and returns Cancelled. Cancellation during execution returns Busy without changing its schedule; caller may retry. Cancel/restart/expire races produce exactly one documented result; callbacks run only in worker context.
verification: Capacity, cancel/expire, restart, wrap, long-callback, backlog and context tests.
configuration: Optional timer count and worker priority/stack; one pending callback per timer; 32-bit unsigned saturating miss counter; explicit Cancelled/Busy results.
resource_budget: Fixed records/callback queue; scan bounded by configured timer count.

title: Bounded work and timing evidence
requirement: Every kernel API and IRQ path shall document work bounds, forbid unbounded callbacks under interrupt masking and expose measured dispatch/interrupt-disabled latency per supported release profile.
acceptance_criteria: Every operation has a finite count-based bound; max-capacity reports pin compiler, configuration, workload and observed durations; explicit application thresholds gate release without a formal WCET claim.
verification: Instrument worst capacities, wait chains, snapshot sizes and timer backlog on target; archive logs.
configuration: All supported profiles; application-defined latency thresholds.
resource_budget: Bounds use fixed thread, mutex, timer, queue and snapshot capacities; fixed instrumentation storage.

title: Boot device registry
requirement: The device registry shall accept unique boot-defined names and static driver objects before sealing at scheduler start.
acceptance_criteria: Duplicate names, null operation tables, capacity overflow and post-start registration fail unchanged; lookup returns the exact registered instance or not-found.
verification: Registry capacity, duplicate, seal and lookup tests.
configuration: Optional devices; positive maximum device count; names at most 31 bytes.
resource_budget: Fixed registry entries and copied bounded names; zero runtime allocation.

title: Unified device operations
requirement: Devices shall expose bounded read, write and typed control operations returning status and transferred byte count, with explicit nonblocking or absolute-deadline modes.
acceptance_criteria: Unsupported operations return not-supported; zero-length operations transfer zero; short transfers report exact progress; expired deadlines never wait; control rejects unknown commands and incorrect payload sizes unchanged.
verification: Mock-driver short transfer, unsupported, deadline and control validation tests.
configuration: Fixed operation table per device; finite control command set.
resource_budget: Caller buffers accessed only during synchronous ownership; abort-uncertain DMA uses fixed driver-owned staging; request state and concurrent operations boot-bounded.

title: Bounded descriptor handles
requirement: Opening a device or file shall acquire a slot from a boot-reserved descriptor table and return an index-plus-generation handle.
acceptance_criteria: Exactly configured slot count opens succeed; excess returns resource-exhausted; close/reopen invalidates old handles; generations never wrap into reuse because exhausted-generation slots retire until reboot.
verification: Exhaustion, stale handle, invalid index and near-generation-limit tests.
configuration: Optional descriptors; configured slot count; 32-bit generation.
resource_budget: Fixed descriptor records; no heap; retired slots remain counted unavailable.

title: Descriptor close lifecycle
requirement: Close shall mark a valid descriptor closing, reject new operations, wait only until its supplied deadline for in-flight operations and release the slot exactly once after quiescence.
acceptance_criteria: Close after successful completion returns invalid-handle. Concurrent close while another close call is active returns Busy. A timed-out close retains Closing state and permits a later same-handle close retry after the first call returns. New I/O is rejected in Closing. Quiescent cleanup releases the slot exactly once; driver-close failure quarantines a diagnosable unavailable slot.
verification: Close versus read/write races, timeout retry and injected close-failure tests.
configuration: Finite per-slot active-operation counter; close uses absolute deadline.
resource_budget: Fixed closing state and active count per descriptor; no detached cleanup allocation.

title: Bounded pathname resolution
requirement: The VFS shall accept explicit bounded byte-span paths, normalize absolute paths with repeated separators and dot components, and reject embedded NUL bytes, traversal above root and symbolic links.
acceptance_criteria: Validate the complete supplied byte span, including bytes after any embedded NUL. Reject excessive span/component lengths before provider calls. /a/../b resolves to /b; /../b and relative paths fail invalid-path; no symbolic links are followed.
verification: Path normalization model and malformed/boundary input tests.
configuration: Optional VFS; positive maximum path bytes, component bytes and component count.
resource_budget: Fixed normalization workspace per configured concurrent resolver; traversal bounded by component count.

title: Static device filesystem
requirement: A devfs provider shall expose sealed device-registry entries under /dev and route opens through descriptor ownership rules.
acceptance_criteria: Every registered exported device appears once; unknown names return not-found; directory iteration is bounded and stable; create, unlink and rename return read-only.
verification: Registry-to-devfs mapping, stable enumeration and forbidden mutation tests.
configuration: Optional devfs; boot export flag per device.
resource_budget: No duplicated driver objects; at most one fixed directory record per exported device.

title: Read-only ROM filesystem
requirement: A ROM filesystem shall expose a boot-linked immutable file table with bounded offset reads and no executable loading.
acceptance_criteria: Reads at EOF return zero; short tail reads are exact; overflowing offsets and invalid table ranges fail; all writes and namespace mutations return read-only; content bytes match linked assets.
verification: ROM image table validation, offset boundaries and content checksum tests.
configuration: Optional ROMFS; fixed file count and linked asset byte budget.
resource_budget: Immutable table and linked bytes; per-open offset stored in descriptor slot.

title: Bounded RAM filesystem
requirement: Optional RAMFS shall use boot-reserved inode and data-block pools, permit only regular files and directories and return explicit exhaustion without growing storage.
acceptance_criteria: Inode/block exhaustion leaves existing contents intact; writes may return documented exact short counts; unlink of open files reclaims blocks only after last close; truncate zeroes newly visible bytes; reboot discards contents.
verification: Pool exhaustion, short write, open-unlink, truncate and repeated create/delete conservation tests.
configuration: Optional RAMFS; fixed inode count, block size, block count and directory-entry capacity.
resource_budget: Exactly configured inode, directory and block pools; ownership counters conserve every slot.

title: Boot mount table
requirement: Mounts shall be registered only at boot with unique absolute normalized prefixes, then remain immutable; resolution shall select the longest component-boundary prefix.
acceptance_criteria: Duplicate prefixes and mount-table overflow fail; /rom does not match /romance; nested mount chooses longest match; runtime mount/unmount returns sealed.
verification: Prefix boundary, nested mount, duplicate, capacity and boot seal tests.
configuration: Fixed mount count; optional devfs, ROMFS and RAMFS providers.
resource_budget: Fixed mount table and bounded copied prefixes; lookup scans at most configured mounts.

title: Static byte pipes
requirement: A pipe shall use a boot-reserved byte ring and bounded endpoint slots, provide partial FIFO transfers and resolve endpoint closure without dynamic allocation.
acceptance_criteria: Empty pipe with writers returns would-block or waits to deadline; empty pipe without writers returns EOF; write without readers returns broken-pipe; close wakes affected waiters; byte order survives ring wrap.
verification: Ring wrap, full/empty, deadline, endpoint-close races and endpoint exhaustion tests.
configuration: Optional pipes; fixed pipe count, bytes per pipe and reader/writer endpoint limits.
resource_budget: Fixed rings and endpoint records; total queued bytes never exceeds configured storage.

title: Built-in command registry
requirement: The shell shall dispatch only a sealed boot-defined table of built-in C++ command functions with unique bounded names.
acceptance_criteria: Duplicate/overlong names fail at boot; unknown commands return command-not-found; dispatch invokes only registered pointers; registry overflow fails unchanged.
verification: Registry validation, unknown command and dispatch identity tests.
configuration: Optional shell; fixed command count and maximum command-name bytes.
resource_budget: Fixed command table; all command code linked into firmware.

title: Bounded shell parser
requirement: The shell shall parse bounded lines with whitespace separation, single/double quoted arguments and backslash escapes, rejecting unsupported expansion, redirection and pipeline syntax initially.
acceptance_criteria: Reject oversized lines, excessive arguments, unmatched quotes and trailing escapes before execution. Preserve quoted spaces and empty arguments. Unquoted expansion, redirection and pipeline metacharacters return parse errors; quoted or escaped metacharacters are literal bytes and never trigger expansion or execution.
verification: Grammar corpus, boundary tests and deterministic fuzzing against reference parser.
configuration: Fixed maximum line bytes and argument count; no environment expansion or command substitution.
resource_budget: One fixed line buffer and argument-index array per shell session.

title: Static shell sessions
requirement: Each enabled shell session shall own boot-reserved input/output buffers and a boot-created worker, with bounded editing and output backpressure.
acceptance_criteria: Session capacity is fixed; line overflow discards until newline and reports one error; output waits only to deadline and reports truncation; disconnected sessions release no borrowed buffer prematurely.
verification: Maximum sessions, oversized line recovery, slow output and disconnect tests.
configuration: Fixed session count, worker priority/stack and input/output ring bytes.
resource_budget: Exactly configured session buffers and stacks; no runtime worker creation.

title: Jobs on boot workers
requirement: Background commands shall run only on a fixed boot-created worker pool with generation-tagged job slots and cooperative cancellation.
acceptance_criteria: Pool exhaustion returns Busy. Jobs run on permanent workers that return to their dispatch loop, never exit. Generation-tagged stale IDs fail; generation-exhausted slots retire until reboot. Cancellation is cooperative without forced unwinding; uncooperative jobs remain occupied and become Stuck after the configured grace interval.
verification: Pool exhaustion, stale IDs, completion/cancel races and noncooperating-job tests.
configuration: Optional jobs; fixed worker/job count, stacks and cancellation grace ticks.
resource_budget: One permanent stack/control block per worker plus fixed job records and bounded copied arguments.

title: Bounded diagnostic commands
requirement: Built-in ps, top, uptime and devices commands shall consume coherent bounded snapshots and print explicit truncation indicators without holding kernel locks during formatting or output.
acceptance_criteria: ps reports name/state/base/effective priority; top handles zero elapsed time and disabled metrics explicitly; rows never exceed caller capacity; slow console output occurs after snapshot lock release.
verification: Snapshot-to-command golden outputs, truncation, disabled metrics and slow-console instrumentation.
configuration: Optional diagnostics; fixed maximum rows and output bytes per command invocation.
resource_budget: Fixed snapshot rows and formatting buffer per session; one snapshot per refresh.

title: UART bounded transport
requirement: The UART driver shall use fixed RX/TX rings, expose nonblocking/deadline transfers and defer interrupt processing through approved bounded paths.
acceptance_criteria: RX overflow drops newest byte and increments a saturating counter; TX full returns short count or waits only to deadline; framing/parity/overrun errors are counted; loopback preserves accepted byte order.
verification: Hardware/model loopback, ring saturation, error injection and deadline tests.
configuration: Optional UART instances; fixed ring bytes, baud and framing selected at boot.
resource_budget: Fixed per-instance rings/control state; ISR work capped at configured bytes per interrupt.

title: Console routing and fault output
requirement: Console input/output shall route to one boot-selected device; panic output shall use a bounded polling path with a fixed byte/time limit and no descriptor locks.
acceptance_criteria: Normal output follows device backpressure; panic writes at most configured bytes and stops at deadline or unavailable device; recursive panic terminates immediately without lock acquisition.
verification: Slow/stuck UART, recursive panic and scheduler-disabled output tests.
configuration: One boot console; optional panic output with positive byte and tick/cycle limits.
resource_budget: Fixed panic buffer and recursion flag; no worker or memory acquisition in panic.

title: GPIO ownership and safe state
requirement: GPIO shall enforce boot-declared pin ownership, validated direction/functions and board-defined safe output values on failed initialization or explicit shutdown.
acceptance_criteria: Conflicting claims and unsupported pin/function fail before hardware changes; writes affect only owned pins; output values are established before enabling drive; failure restores declared safe state.
verification: Mock-register ownership/mask tests and board safe-state measurements.
configuration: Optional fixed pin table and owner map; board safe values required for outputs.
resource_budget: One fixed record per declared pin; no runtime pin claims.

title: SPI bounded transactions
requirement: SPI shall accept transactions from fixed boot request slots, serialize each bus and hold chip select only for one bounded transaction with an absolute completion deadline.
acceptance_criteria: Validate mode/rate/length before assertion; preserve segment order; queue full returns busy; timeout deasserts chip select and returns transferred count; subsequent requests recover or receive unavailable.
verification: Mode validation, contention, full queue, timeout and chip-select waveform tests.
configuration: Optional buses; fixed request count, maximum segments/bytes and supported rates/modes.
resource_budget: Fixed request/control slots and boot driver-owned DMA staging; hardware cannot retain caller or stack buffer references after any return, including errors.

title: I2C error and recovery bounds
requirement: I2C shall serialize bounded address transactions, report NACK/arbitration/timeout distinctly and attempt at most nine recovery clocks followed by STOP before marking a stuck bus unavailable.
acceptance_criteria: Invalid addresses/lengths fail before START; repeated-start sequences preserve atomic ownership; NACK returns exact progress; recovery is attempted once per failed transaction and never exceeds deadline; unavailable buses reject requests until explicit bounded reinitialize.
verification: NACK, arbitration loss, clock stretch, stuck SDA and recovery waveform tests.
configuration: Optional buses; fixed request count/bytes; standard 7-bit addressing initially.
resource_budget: Fixed transaction slots and one bus recovery state per instance.

title: Progress-based watchdog supervision
requirement: A boot-created supervisor shall feed the hardware watchdog only when every enabled critical thread advances its registered progress token within its configured monotonic interval.
acceptance_criteria: A stuck critical worker prevents feeding by its deadline; token wrap is handled; noncritical workers do not inhibit feeding; first missed participant is recorded before reset; watchdog setup is validated against supervisor period.
verification: Stalled worker, interrupt-only activity, token wrap, false-positive margin and actual reset tests.
configuration: Optional supervisor; fixed critical participant list and positive per-participant deadlines.
resource_budget: Fixed token/deadline records plus one boot supervisor stack; one scan per supervision period.

title: Ordered driver boot failure
requirement: Drivers shall initialize through a fixed dependency-ordered boot table; critical failure shall abort startup and reverse-unwind every initialized driver, while optional failure shall clean up that partially initialized driver, skip transitive dependents and retain successful providers.
acceptance_criteria: Reject cycles and unknown dependencies before hardware access. Run partial-driver cleanup even when initialization fails. Critical failure prevents start and cleans initialized drivers once in reverse order. Optional failure cleans only the failed partial driver, skips dependents and retains initialized shared providers. Every cleanup has a deadline; cleanup failure records a fault and preserves safe/unavailable state.
verification: Dependency graph validation and failure injection at every boot-table position.
configuration: Fixed init entry count; critical/optional classification and bounded init/shutdown deadlines.
resource_budget: Fixed table and visited/state arrays; traversal bounded by configured entries/edges.

title: Device request cancellation
requirement: Timed device operations shall return only after hardware has no reference to caller buffers; abort-uncertain DMA hardware shall use boot driver-owned staging or fail driver initialization, and failed abort shall quarantine its request/staging slot.
acceptance_criteria: Both success and fault returns leave caller storage safe to reuse. Abort-uncertain hardware never receives caller addresses. Failed abort retains only driver-owned staging and quarantines it with a distinct fault result. Late completions cannot target reused generations; repeated abort is idempotent.
verification: Delayed DMA completion, abort success/failure, stale completion and slot quarantine tests.
configuration: Fixed abort deadline and request-generation width; asynchronous drivers use driver-owned buffers.
resource_budget: Fixed request slots and staging buffers; quarantined capacity never silently reused.

title: Bounded readiness polling
requirement: A readiness API shall inspect a bounded caller-supplied descriptor set for read/write/error readiness and wait atomically to a deadline without consuming data.
acceptance_criteria: Oversized sets fail before driver calls; already-ready returns immediately; readiness transition between registration and sleep is not lost; closed/stale handles report per-entry error; timeout returns zero ready entries.
verification: Ready-before-wait, transition race, close race, invalid handle and maximum-set tests.
configuration: Optional readiness; configured maximum descriptors per wait.
resource_budget: One boot-reserved readiness record per waiting thread and bounded descriptor indices.

title: Coherent device diagnostics
requirement: Each driver shall expose a bounded typed health snapshot containing availability, fault reason, capacity/occupancy, overflow/error counts and reset generation without clearing counters on read.
acceptance_criteria: Snapshots are internally coherent; counters saturate at maximum rather than wrap; repeated reads have no reset side effect; disabled features return not-supported; fixed output truncation reports required/written rows.
verification: Concurrent update/snapshot, saturation, disabled driver and bounded enumeration tests.
configuration: Optional device metrics with fixed per-driver schema and maximum snapshot rows.
resource_budget: Fixed per-device counters/state and caller-owned snapshot rows; no formatting under driver locks.

title: Ethernet adapter boot contract
requirement: The Ethernet adapter shall initialize once at boot with complete MAC/input callbacks and preserve state on invalid or repeated initialization.
acceptance_criteria: Missing callbacks and second initialization fail unchanged; before initialization link is false, poll returns zero and send errors; callback context remains valid for adapter lifetime.
verification: Initialization boundaries and target callback-lifetime review.
configuration: Optional RTOS_ETHERNET; fixed adapter instance count.
resource_budget: One permanent 1536-byte RX scratch buffer and fixed callback/statistics state per instance.

title: Bounded Ethernet RX validation
requirement: RX polling shall attempt at most its supplied budget, stop on empty/busy/error and reject frames outside 14..1536 bytes before protocol delivery.
acceptance_criteria: Budget zero invokes no receive; N budget invokes at most N receives; malformed lengths never reach input; hardware callbacks never write beyond supplied capacity; errors terminate the call.
verification: Budget/length boundaries, malformed frames and guarded-buffer MAC tests.
configuration: Per-call receive budget; standard/tagged frames without FCS; no jumbo support.
resource_budget: One fixed scratch frame; no per-frame allocation; callback execution independently bounded.

title: Ethernet TX staging and backpressure
requirement: Transmit shall consume/copy valid caller bytes before return, return busy without retaining caller pointers and use boot-reserved staging for asynchronous hardware.
acceptance_criteria: Null/invalid lengths error; accepted send permits immediate caller reuse; busy consumes no caller ownership; full staging returns busy; completion returns each slot exactly once.
verification: Caller overwrite, staging exhaustion, duplicate/late completion and retry tests.
configuration: Configured TX staging slots and maximum 1536-byte frame.
resource_budget: Fixed staging frames and completion metadata; no pool growth.

title: DMA ring ownership and coherency
requirement: MAC DMA shall use aligned boot-reserved rings with free, hardware-owned, completed and quarantined states and board-provided cache/barrier operations.
acceptance_criteria: Every descriptor has one owner; handoff barriers precede ownership bits; cache operations respect lines; duplicate completion faults; abort failure quarantines until reset quiescence.
verification: DMA ownership model, barrier instrumentation and saturation/reset tests.
configuration: Board alignment/cache requirements and fixed RX/TX descriptor counts.
resource_budget: Fixed aligned rings and packet storage; ownership-state counts equal configured slots.

title: PHY and MDIO deadlines
requirement: PHY management shall perform finite MDIO transactions and deadline-bounded reset/autonegotiation, returning unavailable on unsupported identity or deadline expiration.
acceptance_criteria: Stuck-busy transactions expire; invalid address fails before access; reset/negotiation respect absolute deadlines; unsupported PHY never enables traffic.
verification: Busy, missing-PHY, identity and negotiation timeout tests.
configuration: Optional PHY; fixed address and supported identity table.
resource_budget: Fixed transaction state and one sampled link record per interface.

title: Link transition state machine
requirement: The network owner shall process down, negotiating, up and fault transitions, reject new TX while down and quiesce ownership before recycling buffers.
acceptance_criteria: Down rejects send; pending TX completes/errors once; repeated flaps conserve slots; stale generations fail; link reads never wait for negotiation.
verification: Cable flap, pending-TX loss, stale completion and recovery tests.
configuration: Fixed interfaces and bounded transition/recovery deadlines.
resource_budget: One fixed state/generation record per interface; no reconnect allocation.

title: Single network-owner worker
requirement: Each stack instance shall confine MAC polling, protocol entry, timers and stack statistics to one boot-created worker; other threads shall submit bounded requests.
acceptance_criteria: Wrong-worker/recursive entry is rejected or trapped in development; ISR only signals work; full requests return busy. Pending RX, requests and timers each receive a nonzero bounded service budget. At the configured maximum worker residency, remaining work is retained and the worker blocks for at least one tick to permit lower-priority progress. Profiles whose protocol deadlines cannot tolerate this reservation are rejected.
verification: Owner/reentrancy misuse, concurrent requests and bounded fairness tests.
configuration: Fixed worker priority/stack, nonzero RX/request/timer budgets and maximum residency plus mandatory blocking interval.
resource_budget: One boot stack plus fixed request/completion queues per stack.

title: Existing stack integration seam
requirement: An optional existing TCP/IP stack shall integrate behind a version-pinned C/C++ adapter with boot-reserved pools and audited ownership paths.
acceptance_criteria: Chosen version/config cross-builds; forbidden allocator symbols absent; each retained packet has bounded owner/release paths; disabling stack removes code/pools.
verification: Pinned-stack build, negative allocation fixture and ownership audit.
configuration: Optional raw single-owner stack initially; no blanket POSIX claim.
resource_budget: Explicit pool/table budgets; link fits selected board RAM; no claim full networking fits default RAM.

title: Protocol timer servicing
requirement: The network worker shall service protocol deadlines from monotonic kernel time with a finite due-work budget each iteration and no timer reset.
acceptance_criteria: Wrap-safe due times; floods cannot postpone timers beyond configured service budget; excess work is counted and continued next loop; callbacks only in owner context.
verification: Flood, timer burst, wrap and owner-context tests.
configuration: Fixed maximum timers and per-loop timer budget.
resource_budget: Boot timer records; at most configured callbacks per loop.

title: Packet pool conservation
requirement: Packet storage shall use boot-reserved pools with bounded runtime loans, validated ownership transitions and explicit exhaustion results.
acceptance_criteria: Free+loaned+hardware+quarantined counts equal capacity; double release/foreign pointers fail; exhaustion drops/rejects with counters; stress recovers every nonquarantined loan.
verification: Exhaustion, double release, foreign-pointer and conservation stress tests.
configuration: Fixed block sizes/counts and maximum chain length.
resource_budget: Exact pool bytes; no fallback allocator or unbounded chains.

title: Bounded socket-like endpoints
requirement: Optional socket-like endpoints shall borrow generation-tagged boot slots, route calls through the owner worker and return timeout, closed and exhausted outcomes.
acceptance_criteria: Exhaustion immediate; stale handles fail; closing rejects new requests and frees only after quiescence; timed-out callers regain buffers only after ownership resolution.
verification: Exhaustion, stale ID, close/request races and timeout ownership tests.
configuration: Optional endpoint subset; fixed endpoints/requests.
resource_budget: Fixed endpoint records and staging; bounded loans allowed.

title: Optional IPv4 baseline
requirement: An IPv4 profile shall support static address, netmask, gateway and bounded ARP while rejecting malformed lengths/checksums before delivery.
acceptance_criteria: Reject invalid address/mask combinations; malformed IPv4/ARP preserves unrelated state; ARP full evicts oldest-expired then oldest entry; fragmentation initially rejected/counted.
verification: Static routing, ARP capacity/expiry and malformed packet tests.
configuration: Optional IPv4; fixed ARP entries; fragmentation/reassembly disabled initially.
resource_budget: Fixed ARP/routes; no fragment buffers; board total-memory gate.

title: Bounded DHCP client
requirement: Optional DHCP shall use fixed per-interface lease state, capped retries/backoff and remove expired addresses before further application traffic.
acceptance_criteria: Retry/backoff maxima respected; acquisition deadline reports no-address; expiry removes address; link loss pauses acquisition; malformed options do not overrun buffers.
verification: Lease acquire/renew/expire, absent server, flaps and malformed options tests.
configuration: Optional DHCPv4; fixed transactions, retry ceiling and acquisition deadline. Enables internal UDP without requiring public endpoints.
resource_budget: One fixed client state and bounded message buffer/interface. Dedicated internal UDP PCB/slot reservation included.

title: Bounded DNS client
requirement: Optional DNS shall use bounded names, fixed query/cache slots, response deadlines and bounded compression decoding.
acceptance_criteria: Overlong names fail before send; full table returns busy; reply ID/source/question match; loops/depth excess fail; timeout releases once; cache evicts oldest-expired then oldest.
verification: Query/cache exhaustion, timeout, mismatches and compression-loop corpus.
configuration: Optional A records initially; fixed names/queries/cache and decode-step limit. Enables internal UDP without requiring public endpoints.
resource_budget: Fixed query/cache/message bytes; no recursive allocation. Dedicated internal UDP PCB/slot reservation included.

title: Bounded TCP service
requirement: Optional TCP shall enforce fixed connection, send/receive and retransmission budgets, expose partial progress and terminate retry exhaustion without leaking loans.
acceptance_criteria: Connection/byte caps report pressure; loss retransmits within ceiling; timeout/reset/close releases or quarantines every loan; EOF/half-close differ from would-block.
verification: Loss/reorder, capacity, partial I/O, retry exhaustion and close conservation tests.
configuration: Optional TCP; fixed windows/segments/retries and close deadline.
resource_budget: Fixed control blocks and windows; profiles may need larger board RAM.

title: Bounded UDP datagrams
requirement: Optional UDP shall preserve datagram boundaries in fixed endpoint/RX slots, drop newest on full queues and report truncation explicitly.
acceptance_criteria: One receive consumes one datagram; short destination reports copied/original lengths and discards remainder; full counts drop; malformed checksum/length rejects; send pressure preserves caller ownership. Internal UDP service is independently selectable from public endpoint API NXR-061; DHCP/DNS reservations are accounted separately and cannot be consumed by public endpoints.
verification: Boundary/truncation, queue full, checksum and send-pressure tests.
configuration: Optional UDP; fixed endpoints, queued datagrams and payload maximum.
resource_budget: Fixed slots backed by packet loans; no growth.

title: Coherent network health metrics
requirement: Network metrics shall be captured by the owner into bounded snapshots with saturating accepted, discarded, busy, error, pool and link-generation counters.
acceptance_criteria: No concurrent live 64-bit reads on RV32; counters never wrap; protocol rejection and hardware drops distinct; truncation reports required/written rows.
verification: Traffic/snapshot, saturation, owner requests and truncation tests.
configuration: Optional fixed snapshot capacity.
resource_budget: Fixed counters and queued/caller snapshot storage; no formatting under critical paths.

title: Coherent thread snapshots
requirement: Thread snapshots shall copy coherent bounded identity, name, state, base/effective priority, current/idle rows with capacity reporting.
acceptance_criteria: Null/zero returns required count; truncation never overruns; idle last after start; finished rows stable; donated priorities read atomically.
verification: Target snapshot boundaries, priority changes, finished/idle and guarded-output tests.
configuration: Snapshots available with metrics disabled; bounded rows.
resource_budget: Caller rows; masked copy bounded by min(capacity, registered threads+idle).

title: CPU residency timer
requirement: Enabled CPU metrics shall charge monotonic timer deltas exactly once and expose timer-cycle residency, dispatch counts and unassigned startup time.
acceptance_criteria: At a common snapshot timestamp, thread residency plus explicit unassigned startup equals elapsed timer cycles. Accounting boundaries are the timestamp passed to account(); trap work before that boundary is charged outgoing and selection/restore after it incoming. Snapshot accounting advances the same boundary without double-counting. Units are timer cycles; CPU-cycle labeling requires verified timer-to-CPU ratio. Counters are monotonic within the 64-bit session horizon; disabled values zero; utilization rejects zero divisor/overflow.
verification: Target conservation, repeated snapshots, idle/busy and disabled-profile tests.
configuration: RTOS_METRICS; fixed-frequency hardware timer never reset or wrapped in session.
resource_budget: Two 64-bit counters/thread and fixed globals; no floating point.

title: Stack guard detection
requirement: Optional guards shall initialize/check a sentinel at dispatch and diagnostic inspection, recording a bounded fault before halting on corruption.
acceptance_criteria: Injected corruption detected at next check; disabled mode explicitly reports checking disabled; skipped sentinels/prior corruption limitations documented.
verification: Target outgoing/incoming corruption and disabled-profile tests.
configuration: RTOS_STACK_GUARD; no MPU/MMU claim.
resource_budget: One word per stack plus fixed fault record.

title: Incremental stack high-water sampling
requirement: Optional watermarks shall fill unused boot stack regions and scan a configured byte budget per call without reading live saved-frame storage.
acceptance_criteria: Known fill destruction yields conservative usage estimates; scans obey budget; initial fill excludes saved frame; concurrent execution cannot cause invalid reads; values labeled estimates. Scan only suspended noncurrent threads while holding a bounded scheduler lock; current-thread sampling is unavailable unless a target-safe self-capture mechanism is verified. No concurrent C++ stack accesses are permitted.
verification: Fill/frame boundaries, budgets and deep-call/preemption sampling tests.
configuration: Optional watermark; fixed fill and scan budget.
resource_budget: No extra stack buffer; fixed cursor/lowest-observed index per thread.

title: Fixed execution trace ring
requirement: Optional tracing shall append fixed timestamped events to a boot ring with bounded writes, overwrite-oldest and lost-event counts.
acceptance_criteria: Full overwrites oldest once and saturates loss count; committed records never torn; disabled mode removes storage/writes; extraction bounded without locked console I/O.
verification: Wrap, preemption/extraction, saturation and disabled-build tests.
configuration: Optional fixed event width, capacity and mask.
resource_budget: Exact ring bytes and fixed indices/counters.

title: Bounded retained fault record
requirement: Fault handling shall capture one fixed versioned reason, thread, CSR, timestamp and available frame record, freeze mutation and enter bounded halt/reset policy.
acceptance_criteria: Unexpected/guard traps retain cause/PC; nested fault preserves first complete record; unavailable fields invalid; checksum detects partial retention; boot reports before clearing.
verification: Trap, guard, nested-fault and partial-retention injection tests.
configuration: Optional board retention region; halt/watchdog-reset policy.
resource_budget: One fixed record; no allocation, blocking locks or unbounded output.

title: Bounded service recovery
requirement: Optional recovery shall use boot supervisor workers, quiesce ownership first and attempt a finite retry count before leaving service unavailable.
acceptance_criteria: Failed quiescence quarantines; retries terminate; unrelated services progress; successful restart increments generation and rejects stale requests; no implicit thread/kernel restart.
verification: Init/abort failure, retry ceiling, stale request and unrelated-service tests.
configuration: Optional per-service retries, backoff and deadline.
resource_budget: Boot workers and fixed recovery records; quarantine remains until reset-safe.

title: Optional tickless idle
requirement: Optional tickless idle shall arm the earliest pending deadline only when no app is ready and reconcile ticks on wake without resetting hardware time.
acceptance_criteria: No wake later than earliest deadline within granularity; early IRQ reconciles ticks; wrap/horizon/no-deadline cases bounded; RISCue WFI-NOP is not claimed to save energy. Earliest deadline includes enabled network protocol deadlines NXR-059; disabling networking removes that dependency at configuration time.
verification: Early-wake, nearest-deadline, wrap, catch-up and metrics conservation tests.
configuration: Optional tickless; maximum suppression <= INT32_MAX ticks.
resource_budget: Fixed next-deadline metadata; bounded thread/timer scans.

title: C# automation and XDoc gate
requirement: All custom project automation shall use C# with XML documentation comments and warnings-as-errors; only minimal Sphinx configuration and its third-party runtime may use Python.
acceptance_criteria: Scan rejects custom Python outside docs/conf.py; all tooling emits XML docs; missing required documentation and warnings fail build; kernel remains C++.
verification: Inventory and negative undocumented-tool/Python fixtures.
configuration: Pinned .NET SDK; scoped docs exception.
resource_budget: Bounded host inputs; no firmware cost.

title: CMake and toolchain contract
requirement: Supported profiles shall use CMake/Ninja with explicit RV32 ISA, ABI and freestanding flags and reject incompatible toolchains before linking.
acceptance_criteria: Clean host/minimal/RISCue builds pass; probes reject wrong XLEN/ABI/CSR support; ELF attributes match rv32im_zicsr/ilp32; versions recorded.
verification: Preset matrix, incompatible compiler and ELF attribute tests.
configuration: CMake>=3.22; Ninja; RV32IM+Zicsr ILP32.
resource_budget: No runtime storage; bounded build artifacts.

title: Feature dependency validation
requirement: Configuration shall reject enabled services with disabled mandatory dependencies or invalid capacities before compiling firmware.
acceptance_criteria: Negative fixtures cover declared edges and zero/overflow capacities; supported profiles configure; errors name feature/dependency; no runtime fallback.
verification: C# dependency-matrix configure and boundary tests.
configuration: Explicit feature dependency table; positive finite enabled capacities.
resource_budget: Validated capacities determine storage; disabled pools zero.

title: Feature removal evidence
requirement: Disabling a feature shall remove dedicated code and static storage from linked firmware with symbol/map evidence and behavior tests.
acceptance_criteria: Paired otherwise-identical builds prove absent dedicated symbols and zero dedicated pool bytes; disabled API behavior documented/tested; shared code excluded from removal claims.
verification: Paired ELF/map comparison and OFF tests.
configuration: Explicit supported combinations.
resource_budget: Bounded host map inputs; no instrumentation.

title: Configuration ABI signature
requirement: Layout-affecting configuration shall produce a link-checked ABI signature preventing mixed definitions across kernel, drivers and applications.
acceptance_criteria: Two-unit mismatches in metrics/layout/ABI fail link; matching profiles link; versioned signature appears in manifest/diagnostics.
verification: Mismatch and matching-profile fixtures.
configuration: Signature includes public layouts, ISA, ABI and relevant features.
resource_budget: Small immutable record; no hot-path checks.

title: Complete static RAM budget
requirement: Each firmware profile shall report linked storage, reserved stacks, pools and mailbox exclusions and fail link on region overflow.
acceptance_criteria: Report text/rodata/data/BSS/reserves/stacks/pools without double counting; reject mailbox0x7f00 and boot reserve overlap; oversized fixture fails; networking states board RAM need.
verification: C# map budget and overflow fixtures.
configuration: Authoritative board linker map/capacities.
resource_budget: Default RAM ends before0x7f00;4KiB boot reserve; explicit other-board maps.

title: Whole-call-chain stack evidence
requirement: Release stack sizing shall combine compiler usage, assembly frames, helpers and maximum preemption placement with target stress for every boot worker.
acceptance_criteria: Reviewed finite chains include 144-byte trap frame/kernel calls; recursion prohibited or bounded; indirect gaps listed; stack exceeds bound plus margin; stress respects margin. Watermark evidence is required only when that optional diagnostic is enabled; disabling it does not waive static call-chain or target stress evidence.
verification: C# .su aggregation, assembly/indirect review and target depth stress.
configuration: Exact release compiler/optimization and worker margin.
resource_budget: Every configured stack covered; no heap or full-stack temporaries.

title: Allocator audit scope
requirement: Every final application ELF shall pass fail-closed known-allocator audit and independent custom pool inventory without claiming symbol absence proves leak freedom.
acceptance_criteria: nm failure fails; forbidden retained/reachable symbols fail; harmless substrings pass; custom/third-party pools have fixed capacities and ownership tests. Scope includes every enabled third-party pool; a core-only profile need not enable networking.
verification: Audit negative/tool-failure fixtures and pool review.
configuration: Versioned forbidden symbols; every final ELF audited.
resource_budget: Zero general heap; inventoried finite pools.

title: Dynamic initialization rejection
requirement: Firmware linking shall reject runtime constructor/preinitializer arrays and unsupported initialization helpers despite section garbage collection.
acceptance_criteria: Constant initialization links; constructor/preinit negatives fail for intended reason; guard/atexit helpers fail audit; GC cannot silently hide unsupported initializers.
verification: Constant and constructor/preinit/helper fixtures.
configuration: Freestanding C++17; no exceptions/RTTI/runtime initialization.
resource_budget: Zero constructor/preinit section bytes.

title: Dependency pin and license manifest
requirement: Release builds shall record exact compiler, .NET, Sphinx and third-party revisions/hashes and licenses.
acceptance_criteria: Manifest covers shipped direct/transitive dependencies and tools; missing pin/hash/license fails package; offline rebuild uses only declared inputs; updates explicit. Every enabled third-party stack/pool is covered; absent optional networking is recorded as not applicable.
verification: Completeness, archive mutation and missing-license tests.
configuration: Pinned revisions/packages and reviewed updates.
resource_budget: Bounded host inventory; no firmware heap.

title: Reproducible build identity
requirement: Release builds shall capture source revision, dirty digest, normalized configuration and commands/tools and reproduce identical loadable bytes from declared inputs.
acceptance_criteria: Different workspace builds yield identical loadable segments after explicitly nonloadable metadata exclusion; source/config mutation changes identity; maps/symbols bind image hash.
verification: Two-directory rebuild and mutation tests.
configuration: Deterministic path/timestamp policy; complete normalized config.
resource_budget: Small immutable firmware identity; bounded host manifests.

title: Tracker semantic integrity
requirement: The tracker shall preserve stable IDs independent of order and reject duplicates, missing dependencies, cycles, incomplete acceptance and unsupported evidence statuses.
acceptance_criteria: Negative fixtures cover each rule; reorder preserves IDs; Planned has no implementation/test claims; source states require paths; baseline cannot assign runtime Verified.
verification: C# self-tests and reorder/status fixtures.
configuration: Strict canonical JSON/status vocabulary.
resource_budget: Finite catalogue maximum and bounded fields; no firmware cost.

title: Deterministic tracker exports
requirement: Check mode shall reject stale/missing exports without writes and explicit generation shall deterministically produce CSV, review logs and Sphinx views.
acceptance_criteria: Two generations byte-identical; altered catalogue/fingerprint or missing export fails check; check preserves bytes; CSV quotes/newlines round-trip; replacement atomic.
verification: Determinism, stale, read-only and interrupted-generation fixtures.
configuration: Canonical JSON authoritative; explicit generation.
resource_budget: Finite exports; one temporary artifact copy.

title: Evidence path and import safety
requirement: Imports shall validate whole batches before canonical replacement and accept only existing repository evidence without rooted, traversal or symlink escapes.
acceptance_criteria: Malformed/duplicate/cyclic import preserves canonical bytes; rooted/backslash/traversal/missing/symlink paths fail; oversized input rejected before growth; no shell evaluation.
verification: Import, path/symlink and input-limit negatives.
configuration: Configured batch/record/field limits.
resource_budget: Bounded host parsing/temp storage; no firmware impact.

title: Open-source static analysis gate
requirement: Release profiles shall run pinned open-source C++ analyzers with target-correct definitions and fail on selected unsuppressed findings or analyzer failure.
acceptance_criteria: RV32 options recorded; defect fixture fails gate; clean fixture passes; narrow suppressions include reason/reviewer/expiry; missing tool fails; assembly limits stated.
verification: Defect, missing-tool, wrong-definition, suppression-expiry fixtures.
configuration: Opt-in cppcheck, clang_tidy and cpp_analysis CMake targets; compile database per preset; reviewed .clang-tidy profile and scoped Cppcheck suppressions. Release tool pinning remains planned.
resource_budget: Bounded host time/output; no firmware cost.

title: Host reference-model tests
requirement: Pure scheduler, wait, pool and parser logic shall be compared with independent finite models.
acceptance_criteria: Small-state priority/wait/ownership models enumerated; seeded random sequences reproduce; mismatches fail; assembly/MMIO exclusions stated.
verification: Model comparison and seeded operation sequences.
configuration: Finite state/seed/sequence limits.
resource_budget: Host bounded states; production unchanged.

title: Sanitizer and input-fuzz profiles
requirement: Host-testable code shall provide optional bounded sanitizer/fuzz profiles with retained reproducers.
acceptance_criteria: ASan/UBSan suites fail injected overrun/UB; fuzz caps input/steps/time; findings retain minimized seed/config; assembly excluded explicitly.
verification: Sanitizer negatives and parser/frame/path fuzz campaigns.
configuration: Optional host profiles; fixed campaigns.
resource_budget: Capped host runs/input/artifacts; no firmware cost.

title: Target port release matrix
requirement: Every claimed RISCue variant shall execute context, timer, priority, interrupt and fault suites on that exact variant before support claims.
acceptance_criteria: Matrix identifies variant/compiler/clock/config; supported cells have logs/image hashes; missing cells explicitly unverified/unsupported; host tests cannot waive target faults.
verification: RTL/board matrix and missing-cell gate fixture.
configuration: Explicit single-hart M-mode variants.
resource_budget: Each board map fits; bounded run/log budgets.

title: Execution evidence fingerprints
requirement: Release results shall bind test ID, outcome, command, tool versions, source/config/image hashes, variant and logs in immutable attempts.
acceptance_criteria: Input changes invalidate reuse; failures retained; missing logs/failing process cannot pass; retry new identity; source/host/target evidence distinct.
verification: Mutation, missing-log, failed-process, retry preservation tests.
configuration: Versioned evidence schema; process/log limits.
resource_budget: Bounded retention with explicit archive policy.

title: Public API contract completeness
requirement: Every exported API shall specify context, lifecycle, ownership, blocking bound, errors and failure atomicity consistently in headers/manual.
acceptance_criteria: Inventory covers every API; missing fields fail review; invalid-context/error outcomes have tests; defaults/capacities match docs.
verification: API inventory and outcome contract tests.
configuration: Enabled API inventory; versioned errors.
resource_budget: Bounded inventory; existing runtime budgets.

title: Port scope and compatibility claims
requirement: Releases shall document single-hart machine-mode trust and enumerate any POSIX-like subset without implying processes, isolation, fork or executable loading.
acceptance_criteria: Overview/API state shared-address trust; unsupported SMP, FP/vector, TLS/process calls listed; adopted APIs map semantics/errors; exposed unsupported calls return not-supported.
verification: Documentation/API review and compatibility negatives.
configuration: RV32 integer single-hart M-mode; enumerated optional compatibility.
resource_budget: No hidden process/loader/runtime stacks; subset static budgets.

title: Long-run resource conservation
requirement: Release stress shall demonstrate stable pool inventories under declared loan/release/failure workloads without claiming universal leak proof.
acceptance_criteria: At least one million operations per enabled reusable class conserve free+active+quarantined; quiescent active returns baseline; quarantines explained; seed/image/workload retained.
verification: Queue, descriptor, file, job, packet, socket, timer fault stress.
configuration: Explicit per-profile classes; finite time/operations/logs.
resource_budget: Boot pools only; bounded evidence; no fallback heap.

title: Sphinx user manual release gate
requirement: Sphinx documentation shall build nitpicky warnings-as-errors and cover APIs, budgets, drivers, metrics, recovery, limitations and requirement-test traceability.
acceptance_criteria: Strict HTML passes; every ID in traceability; Planned labeled; examples compile in stated profiles; no false target/certification claims.
verification: Sphinx, traceability and example compile gates.
configuration: Sphinx mandatory; minimal conf.py exception; pinned dependencies.
resource_budget: Bounded manual artifacts; no firmware cost.

title: Fault and configuration qualification
requirement: Supported release profiles shall have requirements-linked fault matrices for exhaustion, invalid config, traps, deadline failure and unavailable hardware.
acceptance_criteria: Every applicable error maps test/expected state; faults conserve/quarantine ownership; invalid config fails before activation; untested cells block qualification visibly.
verification: Negative builds and model/target fault campaigns.
configuration: Supported profiles; finite cases/seeds.
resource_budget: Boot resources; injection metadata absent when OFF.

title: Four builder review checkpoints
requirement: Requirements shall receive independent builder assessments and actual build, test, audit, analyzer, Sphinx checkpoints at 25, 50, 75, 100 with corrections and failed attempts retained.
acceptance_criteria: Each boundary retains snapshots, disposition, commands, exits, log hashes; findings/failures block acceptance; retries preserved; scope states requirements and unchanged-runtime baseline. Historical baseline analyzer scans are source checks and do not establish release analyzer gate NXR-090 or target execution evidence NXR-094.
verification: Checkpoint schema/missing-gate/failure tests and four recorded executions.
configuration: Four fixed boundaries; separate implementation qualification.
resource_budget: Finite command/log limits and immutable attempts; no firmware cost.

title: Modular static configuration
requirement: The system shall separate mandatory kernel, architecture port, BSP and optional services, with validated target and independent feature profiles generated using C# with XDoc.
acceptance_criteria: List targets and minimal/default/diagnostic profiles; deterministic cache generation; invalid identity/capacity/topology fails; OFF Ethernet omits its library; no runtime loading or heap; planned ports fail before compiler selection.
verification: C# configuration tests, supported preset builds and negative CMake profiles.

resource_budget: All configured firmware storage fixed before start; configurator catalogue <=1MiB.

requirement: Architecture-specific context construction, interrupt control, trap classification and timer access shall reside in selected architecture ports with explicit frame and ABI contracts.
acceptance_criteria: Kernel has no inline assembly; RISCue preserves its36-word frame and gp/tp initialization; ports never share incompatible assembly; 64-bit ports replace fixed32-bit context assumptions before support claims.
verification: RV32 cross-build, disassembly/frame review and per-port register canary tests.
configuration: Compile-time selected port; no runtime virtual dispatch.
resource_budget: Fixed per-thread frame and per-CPU port state; no heap.

requirement: Provisional VORAGO VA108xx Cortex-M0 and VA416xx Cortex-M4 profiles shall require confirmed part/board, separate architecture capabilities and vendor-accurate BSP before firmware enablement.

verification: Exact-part cross-build plus vector, full register, preemption, fault and noheap target suites.

requirement: The Zynq-7000 ARMv7-A target shall bind a specific board/part, boot handoff, exception mode, GIC, timer and cache/MMU policy before firmware enablement.

verification: Board-specific cross-build, context/IRQ/timer/cache ownership and target qualification.

requirement: The Zynq UltraScale+ Cortex-R5F target shall define split/lockstep mode, TCM map, boot ownership, MPU, interrupt and timer policy before firmware enablement.
acceptance_criteria: Selected mode matches firmware/map; CPU count counts logical contexts; TCM/DDR and A53 shared regions partitioned; FP disabled or context-qualified; remote reset and DMA ownership bounded.
verification: R5 board context, timer, fault, TCM, interprocessor visibility and noheap qualification.

verification: AArch64 compile/layout fixtures and exact-board register/timer/interrupt/cache suites.

requirement: Classic32-bit MicroBlaze shall have its own generated-hardware-specific port with pinned compiler ABI, endian, vector, cache, timer and interrupt options.

verification: Hardware/compiler mismatch negatives and context/IRQ/timer/cache/noheap suites.

requirement: Tang Nano9K support shall bind FPGA bitstream, selected RISC-V core, timer/IRQ/CSR behavior, clocks and memory map rather than infer CPU support from board name.
acceptance_criteria: Confirm soft core; RISCue pairing provisional; oscillator not assumed CPU/timer clock; validate synthesized map and timing; custom PicoRV IRQ cannot reuse machine-mode port; PSRAM controller/init and worst-case timing qualified before kernel stack placement.
verification: Bitstream identity, CSR/IRQ/timer and memory timing tests plus board qualification.
configuration: Provisional RISCue RV32 profile on Gowin GW1NR-9; board/core selection explicit.

requirement: Future SMP shall use statically reserved per-CPU current/idle state and IRQ stacks with cross-CPU synchronization, affinity and remote rescheduling.
