title: Future partitioned AMP contract
requirement: Future AMP shall use independently booted kernel images with partitioned memory, timer/IRQ ownership and bounded shared-memory communication.
acceptance_criteria: Image/memory/IRQ owner manifest prevents overlap; boot/reset handshake finite; cache visibility and message ownership explicit; stale reset generations rejected; lockstep counted as one logical CPU; current unsupported AMP rejected.
verification: Dual-image boot/reset, mailbox saturation, cache visibility and isolation tests.
configuration: Independent per-ISA static images; fixed mailboxes; AMP disabled initially.
resource_budget: Boot-reserved per-image memory and bounded shared regions; no shared heap.

title: Architecture-specific port qualification
requirement: Each new architecture/board profile shall remain planned until its exact context ABI, startup, timer, interrupt, memory and ownership evidence is recorded.
acceptance_criteria: Correct compiler ELF attributes; all integer and enabled FP/SIMD/TLS state tested; nested IRQ policy, rollover/catch-up, priority, noheap/constructors and stack/link overflow pass; logs bind board/bitstream/image/config; unexecuted cells remain unverified.
verification: Per-port compile/disassembly and exact RTL/board matrix with failure injections.
configuration: Explicit architecture/board/configuration matrix; enabled optional state enumerated.
resource_budget: Fixed test stacks/pools and bounded retained evidence per target.

title: Native C# host tool targets
requirement: Every project C# host tool with Native AOT support shall provide a native publish target and execute natively by default throughout CMake, CTest and firmware auditing.
acceptance_criteria: Publish audit, tracker and configurator for build-host OS/CPU, never firmware ISA; native_tools builds all; tests and ELF audits invoke executables directly; XML docs emitted beside binaries; reflection JSON disabled with generated metadata; AOT/linker warnings fail; unsupported hosts require explicit managed compatibility selection; Linux native self-tests, tracker import/generation and firmware audit pass.
verification: Native publish logs, executable format inspection, CTest command inspection, all CLI self-tests and RV32 audit/static-contract build using host-native tools.
configuration: RTOS_NATIVE_TOOLS=ON default; OFF explicitly enables managed compatibility; host-specific RID.
resource_budget: Native host tools may use host heap; firmware pools/stacks and noheap audits unchanged; separate host build output directories.

title: Static device registry
requirement: The kernel shall register permanent device objects before scheduling and seal a finite registry against runtime registration.
acceptance_criteria: Duplicate identities and exclusive MMIO overlaps fail; unavailable devices cannot open; register-only drivers need no worker.
verification: Future boot-registry boundary review and tests.
configuration: RTOS_DEVICE proposed, off in nano.
resource_budget: Fixed object table and per-device state; zero runtime allocation.

title: Minimal driver operations
requirement: The driver framework shall define initialize, read, write and typed control operations with explicit context, ownership and result contracts.
acceptance_criteria: Missing optional operations return unsupported without MMIO; example register driver needs no queue, heap or hidden thread; callback blocking and bounded-work rules are documented.
verification: Future API review and example-driver checks.
configuration: Optional direct-access driver module.
resource_budget: One permanent object and operations table per device; target size reported.

title: Whole device transaction lock
requirement: The driver framework shall serialize each complete logical device transaction across all thread entry points using the same priority-inheriting mutex.
acceptance_criteria: Concurrent callers cannot interleave transaction steps; normal errors release ownership; aliases follow the same lock; reserved hardware stays owned across completion waits.
verification: Future forced-preemption transaction scenarios.
configuration: Direct locked access default when device sharing is enabled.
resource_budget: One static mutex per serialization domain; no mandatory request queue.

title: Bounded priority inheritance
requirement: The kernel shall implement owner-aware nonrecursive mutexes with separate base and effective priorities and bounded transitive priority donation.
acceptance_criteria: Donation propagates through valid chains; timeout, unlock and priority change recompute donations; highest effective priority then FIFO selects waiters; self-lock and cycles fail before sleep.
verification: Future inversion, chained donation and cycle scenarios.
configuration: RTOS_MUTEX_PI proposed; dependency required by shared-device locking.
resource_budget: Static mutex objects and thread wait metadata; traversal bounded by thread count.

title: Typed MMIO access contracts
requirement: The port and driver framework shall validate register aperture, width and alignment and define ordering, endian and side-effect semantics for MMIO.
acceptance_criteria: Overflowing or out-of-aperture accesses fail before hardware access; read-only and write-one-to-clear registers use appropriate operations; barriers are port-defined; no implicit destructive readback.
verification: Future MMIO fake-backend review and target ordering qualification.
configuration: Per-device register map and per-port ordering hooks.
resource_budget: Compile-time register descriptors plus bounded validation; no heap.

title: Race-free completion wait
requirement: The kernel shall atomically enroll device waiters with condition checks and use persistent generation-tagged completion state and one absolute deadline.
acceptance_criteria: Completion before or during wait enrollment is preserved; wake rechecks predicate; old generations cannot complete new commands; retries do not extend deadline.
verification: Future interrupt-at-each-boundary and timeout-race scenarios.
configuration: Per-device completion predicate and finite deadline.
resource_budget: Static completion generation, predicate and waiter metadata.

title: Explicit ISR operation boundary
requirement: The kernel shall provide separately named nonblocking ISR-safe operations with bounded work and deferred rescheduling at interrupt exit.
acceptance_criteria: Blocking APIs reject interrupt context; BSP documents acknowledge and nesting; higher-priority unblocked thread runs at the permitted boundary; peripheral IRQ capability remains unavailable until dispatch exists.
verification: Future external-interrupt dispatch and nesting qualification.
configuration: Per-port external interrupt support explicitly enabled only when qualified.
resource_budget: Static handlers and bounded deferred state; no ISR heap.

title: AXI timeout and fault isolation
requirement: The driver framework shall distinguish lock timeout, device completion timeout and AXI access failure and keep uncertain hardware faulted until owned recovery establishes quiescence.
acceptance_criteria: FPGA integration specifies bounded bus error response or independent timeout; partial commands fault device; reset requires ownership and IRQ quiescence; no timeout is treated as proof that hardware stopped.
verification: Future stalled-device and interconnect fault qualification.
configuration: Board-specified AXI error responder, timeout and reset policy.
resource_budget: Static fault state and counters; hardware timeout resource declared separately.

title: Optional queued device service
requirement: The driver framework shall optionally serialize slow operations through a statically provisioned request queue and worker with explicit data lifetime and cancellation rules.
acceptance_criteria: Queue and worker are opt-in; capacity exhaustion returns full; ordering policy is documented; retained data stays valid; queued cancellation differs from cancellation after issuing hardware commands; DMA remains deferred.
verification: Future worker ownership and cancellation scenarios.
configuration: Optional worker, capacity and FIFO or priority policy.
resource_budget: Fixed request storage plus explicit worker control block and stack.

title: Typed static message queue
requirement: The kernel shall provide fixed-capacity Queue<T,N> objects for positive N and initially trivially copyable messages with copied ownership and FIFO message order.
acceptance_criteria: Successful send copies payload before return; receive preserves message order; no constructors or allocator calls hide in transfer; target payload, alignment, control and waiter costs are reported.
verification: Future queue ownership, boundary and footprint scenarios.
configuration: RTOS_QUEUE proposed; capacity and message type fixed at boot.
resource_budget: N times sizeof(T) plus exact control/alignment and static wait metadata.

title: Timed queue transfer semantics
requirement: The kernel shall provide immediate and timed queue send and receive with priority-ordered waiters, FIFO ties and exactly one transfer-or-timeout outcome.
acceptance_criteria: NoWait returns full or empty immediately; receive failure preserves output; transfer and timeout serialize; selected waiter owns the granted slot or message before competitors can steal it.
verification: Future queue full, empty, handoff and simultaneous-timeout scenarios.
configuration: NoWait, bounded timeout and documented indefinite-wait option.
resource_budget: Wait state lives in permanent thread metadata; no per-wait allocation.

title: ISR-safe queue transfer
requirement: The kernel shall provide bounded nonblocking queue operations for supported interrupt contexts using a verified port synchronization protocol.
acceptance_criteria: ISR send and receive return full or empty explicitly; nested producers preserve indices and ownership; no overwrite or unbounded retry; configurable payload cap bounds ISR copy work.
verification: Future nested-interrupt queue and work-bound qualification.
configuration: Explicit ISR transfer methods and maximum ISR message bytes.
resource_budget: Same fixed queue storage plus port critical-section state.

title: Event flag wait semantics
requirement: The kernel shall provide fixed-width event flags with validated masks, wait-any, wait-all, returned observed bits and atomic optional clear-on-success.
acceptance_criteria: Zero and unsupported masks fail unchanged; timeout consumes no bits; repeated sets coalesce; wait-all requires all requested bits; counting use cases are directed to semaphores.
verification: Future mask, any/all and clear-on-success scenarios.
configuration: RTOS_EVENTS proposed; documented usable mask and clear mode.
resource_budget: One static flag word and bounded waiter metadata per event object.

title: Event wake and payload ordering
requirement: The kernel shall serialize event updates and wait enrollment and define priority consumption and broadcast behavior separately.
acceptance_criteria: Non-clearing waits evaluate a documented snapshot; consuming waits evaluate by priority and remaining bits; ISR set never blocks; payload ownership and visibility require an explicit separate contract.
verification: Future multi-waiter clear, broadcast and ISR-set scenarios.
configuration: Explicit broadcast versus consuming wait policy.
resource_budget: Fixed event state and existing thread wait metadata.

title: Bounded counting semaphore
requirement: The kernel shall provide statically allocated counting semaphores with validated initial and maximum counts, bounded waits and direct priority waiter handoff.
acceptance_criteria: Overflow fails unchanged; release grants selected waiter before exposing count to contenders; timeout cannot duplicate tokens; ISR release is nonblocking; semaphore has no ownership or priority inheritance.
verification: Future count conservation and release-timeout race scenarios.
configuration: RTOS_SEMAPHORE proposed; boot-fixed initial and maximum counts.
resource_budget: Fixed count, maximum and waiter metadata; zero heap.

title: Bounded thread wait lifecycle
requirement: The kernel shall track at most one active blocking operation per thread initially and remove wait membership exactly once on grant, timeout or supported termination.
acceptance_criteria: Blocking before start or from idle fails; timeout range respects modular tick limits; stale wake cannot affect a later wait; internal links are not application-owned; each path removes one wait registration.
verification: Future wait-state transition and stale-wakeup scenarios.
configuration: One active wait per thread; supported finite tick range documented.
resource_budget: Permanent thread wait metadata with bounded object lookup.

title: Abandoned device ownership
requirement: The kernel shall report owner-dead and fault a device when its mutex owner exits during an uncertain transaction until explicit recovery restores a safe state.
acceptance_criteria: Waiters receive distinct failure; no implicit successful unlock; donation and wait references are removed; recovery requires ownership; fatal corruption is not promised recoverable.
verification: Future owner-exit at each transaction boundary scenarios.
configuration: Explicit owner-dead recovery policy; no dynamic thread reclamation.
resource_budget: Static abandonment and recovery state; no reallocation.

title: Device and IPC metrics
requirement: The kernel shall copy coherent bounded device and IPC snapshots into caller-provided storage with separate contention, capacity, timeout and fault statistics.
acceptance_criteria: Snapshots include mutex owner and effective priority, waiter counts, queue capacity/depth/high-water, full results, timeout/error/recovery; counters saturate safely; count-only query allocates nothing.
verification: Future snapshot coherence and saturation scenarios.
configuration: Metrics independently configurable; costs reported when enabled.
resource_budget: Fixed per-object counters and caller-owned output arrays.

title: Modular synchronization configuration
requirement: The build configuration shall independently enable device, queue, event, semaphore and mutex modules with validated dependencies and explicit single-hart support limits.
acceptance_criteria: Nano disables all new modules; invalid dependencies fail configuration; disabled storage disappears; IRQ masking is never advertised as an SMP lock; CMake and C# XDoc policies remain in force.
verification: Future configuration matrix and target footprint audits.
configuration: Proposed RTOS_DEVICE, RTOS_QUEUE, RTOS_EVENTS, RTOS_SEMAPHORE and RTOS_MUTEX_PI.
resource_budget: Disabled features contribute zero module storage; enabled sizes measured per target.

title: Small bounded logging and documentation
requirement: The kernel shall keep optional static logging capacity configurable, use drop-new initially, bound synchronous drain work and document all proposed APIs and deferred DMA scope honestly.
acceptance_criteria: Depth and payload have explicit costs; truncation and full losses differ; buffers remain owned until consumed; ISR formatting is context-safe; no unverified RAM saving or DMA cancellation claim appears in the manual.
verification: Future logging capacity, drain budget and ownership scenarios.
configuration: Logging off in nano; explicit fixed depth and message bytes.
resource_budget: Depth times actual slot size plus formatting and synchronization metadata reported separately.

title: Optional simple FPGA DMA driver
requirement: The BSP shall optionally support one selected FPGA DMA engine after interrupt and IPC prerequisites, with one active transfer per channel and fixed aligned buffers.
acceptance_criteria: Driver serializes thread callers; interrupt completion signals a waiter; invalid alignment, length or busy channel fails unchanged; scatter/gather, cyclic transfers and automatic exit cancellation remain excluded initially; disabled DMA adds no driver storage.
verification: Future selected-engine transfer and configuration qualification.
configuration: Proposed RTOS_DMA optional, off in nano; actual engine selected by BSP.
resource_budget: Static channel state and explicit buffer capacities/alignment; report exact target costs.

title: DMA buffer ownership and quiescence
requirement: The DMA driver shall retain exclusive hardware buffer ownership until verified completion or proven quiescence and quarantine uncertain transfers after timeout or owner exit.
acceptance_criteria: Timeout alone never releases a buffer; recovery proves engine stop/reset before reuse; stale completion cannot release a newer transfer; errors and quarantine are observable; no unbounded abort wait is permitted.
verification: Future timeout, delayed completion, reset and owner-exit fault scenarios.
configuration: Per-engine bounded completion/reset policy; no generic cancellation promise.
resource_budget: Fixed ownership/generation and quarantine state; retained buffers remain charged to static budget.

title: DMA address and cache contract
requirement: The BSP shall define DMA-reachable bus address ranges, width, alignment, cache maintenance and ordering independently from CPU virtual or physical pointer representation.
acceptance_criteria: Overflowing or unreachable ranges fail before launch; cache operations respect complete owned cache lines; direction and barriers are explicit; unsupported coherency or addressing fails configuration; no IOMMU is assumed.
verification: Future BSP mapping review and coherency qualification.
configuration: Selected engine and memory-region manifest; coherent or maintained buffers explicit.
resource_budget: Static aligned regions and mapping metadata; cache-line padding reported.

title: Conditional SpaceVPX PCIe transport
requirement: The BSP plan shall treat PCIe over SpaceVPX as a conditional optional transport with explicit endpoint or root-port scope and a required hardware integration manifest.
acceptance_criteria: Manifest records IP/revision, role, generation, lanes, slot profile, peer, BAR/windows, address width, IRQ, reset and performance budgets; endpoint registers may precede DMA; root-port enumeration is separately scoped; no SpaceVPX qualification is implied.
verification: Future hardware selection and interface design review.
configuration: Proposed RTOS_PCIE off by default; role and IP remain undecided.
resource_budget: Declared BAR/control storage only; root-port tables and DMA buffers separately budgeted.

title: Versioned peer communication protocol
requirement: The PCIe transport shall define a versioned fixed-width register/mailbox protocol with explicit endian, bounds, ordering, ownership and backpressure before bulk DMA is enabled.
acceptance_criteria: Incompatible versions fail safely; lengths and ranges validate without overflow; native pointers and C++ layouts never cross the link; reset generations reject stale responses; synchronization follows actual bridge semantics.
verification: Future peer conformance and malformed-message scenarios.
configuration: Static mailbox depth and message bounds; register-only mode supported where hardware permits.
resource_budget: Fixed mailbox storage and protocol state; no mandatory DMA buffers.

title: PCIe fault and DMA window isolation
requirement: The PCIe BSP shall bound accessible peer and local windows and preserve ownership through link loss, reset and uncertain outstanding DMA until quiescence is established.
acceptance_criteria: Reject out-of-window access before submission; link loss faults pending work; buffers remain reserved until hardware-specific recovery proves safety; reconnect rejects stale generations; IRQ and posted-write ordering follow selected IP; fault counters are exposed.
verification: Future link-drop, reset, range-validation and late-write qualification.
configuration: Board-specific windows, interrupt mechanism and reset/quiescence policy.
resource_budget: Static window, request-generation and health records; quarantine budget explicit.

title: Single-hart atomic RAM words
requirement: The kernel shall provide 32-bit RAM load, store, exchange, compare-exchange, fetch-add and bitwise fetch operations with interrupt serialization by default, and an independent default-off RISCue Zaamo word-RMW backend, without libatomic or heap dependencies.
acceptance_criteria: All access uses the object; compare mismatch updates expected; unsigned addition wraps; nested critical state restores correctly; documentation excludes MMIO, DMA and SMP semantics; native target allocator audit remains clean.
verification: Host operation/HAL fixtures and matched baseline/Zaamo real-kernel RTL runs with ticket, bit-ownership, exchange-history, compare-exchange, interrupt and guard checks; physical target qualification remains separate.
configuration: RTOS_SYNC; current single-hart ports. RTOS_ZAAMO defaults OFF and requires RISCue firmware plus explicit atomic-capable RAM; separate matched baseline and feature builds.
resource_budget: One 32-bit word plus alignment; bounded interrupt masking and no runtime allocation.

title: Bounded queued printf formatting
requirement: The logger shall format a documented integer/string subset into private bounded storage and publish complete copied records without holding a formatting lock or waiting for UART output.
acceptance_criteria: Support documented conversions with matched varargs; reject unsupported format without enqueue; cap format and string scans; report truncation/full; retain pending bytes across partial writes; ISR path accepts preformatted bytes only; physical UART integration remains separate.
verification: Host format/queue/backpressure fixtures, RV32 static-only link and future target stack/latency/UART qualification.
configuration: RTOS_LOGGING requires RTOS_SYNC; fixed logger depth and record size.
resource_budget: RV32 Logger of 8 records with 64 message bytes occupies 720 bytes in the measured example; private formatter consumes reserved thread stack space.

title: Simple application starting surface
requirement: The project shall provide a short application guide and optional convenience header showing copied messages, scoped device transactions and queued printf while preserving existing low-level APIs.
acceptance_criteria: One header exposes enabled services without automatic allocation; named event waits avoid positional mode booleans; existing signatures remain valid; a small console example cross-links with a labeled counting sink and explicit board clock replacement; detailed ISR and ownership contracts remain accessible.
verification: Public-header host fixtures, console firmware link/audit, documentation build and future board integration.
configuration: RTOS_SYNC and optional RTOS_LOGGING; existing nano remains feature-off.
resource_budget: Convenience includes have no independent runtime storage; example objects and stacks are statically reserved.

title: Annotated sources and minimal application build
requirement: The project shall publish commented C++ contracts, a complete current-port assembly explanation and a reproducible minimal application build in its Sphinx manual.
acceptance_criteria: Sphinx includes actual source listings; every startup/context instruction has a meaningful comment; frame offsets match the constructor; the nano walkthrough identifies clock and map inputs, commands, ELF/map outputs and memory inspection; native and firmware checks pass without claiming board execution.
verification: Strict Sphinx build, source/frame review, cross-build and comparison of emitted assembly text; target register preservation remains a separate gate.
configuration: Existing nano profile and documentation build; no new runtime service.
resource_budget: Comments and host-side manual add no firmware objects; example retains one static application stack and control block.

title: Source-backed HTML developer guide
requirement: The project shall generate a standalone how-it-works HTML guide covering scheduling, application builds, driver ownership and the current assembly boundary.
acceptance_criteria: The native C# tool inserts escaped current minimal and assembly sources and measured footprint; the host preview serves the guide; application and AXI driver examples label hardware placeholders; the guide is excluded from the minimal firmware image.
verification: Native generation, local HTML preview, strict Sphinx references and cross-build/audit.
configuration: Host-side HTML and native Workbench; no new RTOS runtime module.
resource_budget: Host documentation only; complete source listings do not add nano firmware storage.

title: FPGA port hardware handoff validation
requirement: The configurator shall validate explicit Tang Nano RISCue and classic MicroBlaze hardware descriptions while keeping missing CPU and BSP ports disabled.
acceptance_criteria: Reject unknown core contracts, missing RAM/timer/interrupt inputs, overflow and incompatible ISA; templates preserve unknown addresses as null; classic MicroBlaze toolchain requires SDK feature/endian inputs; no firmware readiness flag is promoted by metadata checks.
verification: Native configuration self-tests, incomplete-template rejection and future SDK/board qualification.
configuration: Staged Tang Nano RISCue and classic MicroBlaze; firmware remains disabled.
resource_budget: Host metadata only; no runtime allocation or guessed hardware register map.

title: Explicit boot-stack RAM budget
requirement: The RISCue build shall expose a validated boot-stack reserve and derive the footprint reserve from final linker symbols.
acceptance_criteria: Default remains 4096 bytes; reject malformed, unaligned or out-of-range settings and image overlap; footprint rejects missing symbols and counts the actual reserve; document startup and first-trap call-chain analysis.
verification: Default and reduced-reserve cross-links, invalid configuration rejection, footprint comparison and later board stack qualification.
configuration: RTOS_BOOT_STACK_BYTES decimal 512..32512 aligned 16; default 4096.
resource_budget: No new runtime storage; reserved boot stack is explicit and separate from thread stacks.

title: Ground-linked diagnostic packages
requirement: The optional diagnostic service shall accept ground-linked flat images for a boot-reserved execution slot without target ELF parsing or symbol resolution.
acceptance_criteria: Ground tool uses exact firmware ID, ISA, ABI and slot address; rejects unresolved relocations and unsupported runtime features; manifest bounds entry, initialized data and BSS; moving the slot requires relinking or ground relocation.
verification: Future native C# packager checks, malformed package cases, exact-slot linking and qualified target execution.
configuration: Optional default-off service; fixed address and capacity; native C# XDoc ground tooling.
resource_budget: Fixed slot includes code/constants/data/BSS; no heap or runtime thread registration.

title: Diagnostic activation and ownership
requirement: The diagnostic worker shall validate and publish uploaded code only while the reserved slot is quiescent and board execution coherency is established.
acceptance_criteria: Precreated worker and scratch capacity; bounded authenticated transfer according to mission policy; digest alone is not authentication; no retained overlay callbacks; explicit states; cache publication hook required; failed transfers stay inactive; hung-code recovery uses qualified watchdog/reset.
verification: Future transfer state-machine and stale-reference checks, cache publication review and hardware fault recovery exercises.
configuration: One optional permanent worker and slot; default off; no forced concurrent unload.
resource_budget: Fixed worker stack/control, bounded receiver state/buffer; avoid a second full image buffer.

title: Board-qualified QSPI boot and XIP
requirement: A QSPI boot target shall distinguish flash storage with RAM copy from memory-mapped execute-in-place and declare its actual startup and flash-busy contract.
acceptance_criteria: Verify reset path, instruction-fetch mapping, flash mode, cache/latency and erase/program behavior; XIP linker separates load and execution addresses and startup copies writable data; code required during flash busy resides in safe memory; publish measured RAM only after cross-link and board validation.
verification: Future board memory-map review, boot/data-copy execution, flash-busy interrupt exercises and measured footprint.
configuration: Board-specific optional boot/XIP adapter; existing flat RAM remains supported.
resource_budget: Writable data and stacks remain in RAM; account bootstrap, RAM handlers and controller buffers explicitly.

title: Three-worker PLAIN RISCue AXI UART simulation
requirement: The project shall provide a static three-worker UART demo executing actual firmware on the existing PLAIN RISCue AXI core with C# SharpTestBench serial verification.
acceptance_criteria: Equal-priority workers retain independent arithmetic state; first records show all workers began during non-yielding work; decode physical UART bits and verify repeated per-thread sequence/results; detect fatal/unexpected traps; preserve exact source and binary identities; use no custom Python tooling.
verification: Native C# runner, actual RV32 cross-build/allocation audit, Verilator execution and SharpTestBench UART arithmetic/preemption checks.
configuration: Optional RTOS_SIMULATION host tools; uart firmware preset with SYNC, LOGGING, METRICS, guards and round robin; PLAIN CPU and ordinary simulation RAM.
resource_budget: Three permanent 1536-byte worker stacks, 512-byte idle stack, fixed logger and 4096-byte boot reserve; measure the larger final demo separately from nano.

title: Bounded Cortex-M3 real-kernel IPC stress
requirement: The project shall provide a boot-static Cortex-M3 simulation port and bounded stress campaign exercising actual thread context switches, FIFO messages, semaphore handoffs, timeouts and priority-inheriting mutexes.
acceptance_criteria: Execute QEMU MPS2 AN385 with three virtual timer timings; verify message sequence/payload conservation, token conservation, contention, low-owner priority donation, CPU-load preemption, finite deadlines and stack sentinels; fail on timeout, guest failure or missing success marker; retain logs and firmware hash.
verification: Native C# runner, Cortex-M3 firmware link and no-heap audit, three QEMU guest runs and existing host regressions.
configuration: Optional RTOS_ARM_SIMULATION; arm-stress preset with SYNC, metrics, guards and round robin; one privileged Cortex-M3 with SVC/SysTick and no external IRQ dispatch.
resource_budget: Nine permanent 2048-byte application stacks, 1024-byte idle stack, eight-slot FIFO, fixed synchronization objects and 4096-byte exception/boot reserve; no target heap.

title: Opt-in bounded stack watermark observations
requirement: The kernel shall provide opt-in boot stack painting and explicit budgeted stack observations without adding per-thread storage or scanning in scheduling paths.
acceptance_criteria: Paint before context creation; scan at most floor(budget_bytes/4) words plus a separate guard check; reject unregistered identities without output mutation; report disabled and incomplete observations explicitly; cover bounds and ARM worker stacks.
verification: Host scanner boundary matrix, ARM real-stack observations, no-heap audit and feature-off cross-build.
configuration: RTOS_STACK_WATERMARK defaults off; explicit stack_usage scan budget defaults to 256 bytes.
resource_budget: No target heap and no new thread-control fields; constant result storage; scan work bounded by caller budget and registered extent.

title: Bounded simulation subprocesses and dependency identities
requirement: Simulation runners shall bound child execution and redirected-output draining, preserve bounded partial diagnostics, and identify verification/runtime dependencies before publishing passing evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Native process fixtures cover exit propagation, timeout, inherited pipes and output cap; UART manifests include managed/native/runtime dependencies and reject changed identities; native-tool fingerprints include shared sources.
verification: Native C# process fixtures and actual ARM/UART simulation reruns.
configuration: Native AOT C# runners with XDoc; one deadline for exit and drains, bounded cleanup and eight-million-character output cap.
resource_budget: Host-only bounded capture; no firmware RAM, heap or thread changes.

title: Cross-port initialization and allocator rejection contracts
requirement: Implemented firmware ports shall reject unsupported initializer, preinitializer and finalizer sections including priority subsections and run positive and negative compiler contracts for their selected ISA.
acceptance_criteria: Both linkers reject array subsection variants despite section GC; native audit recognizes dotted constructor and reentrant allocator names; ARM and RV32 static_contract_check run compiler-negative fixtures.
verification: Native C# symbol self-tests and real ARM/RV32 compiler-linker fixtures.
configuration: Architecture-selected static_contract_check; no default libc or libgloss linking.
resource_budget: Host fixtures only; no target heap or runtime constructor machinery.

title: ARM register and alignment validation
requirement: The Cortex-M3 simulation stress shall check callee-saved state across blocking SVC and integer register plus NZCV state across interrupt-only regions, including injected mismatch detection and PSP padding.
acceptance_criteria: Distinct canaries pass, injected r7 mismatch returns zero, ticks progress in the positive interrupt harness, and four-byte PSP alignment produces the hardware padding flag.
verification: Three QEMU timer shifts per configured stress image.
configuration: Assembly harnesses preserve AAPCS caller state and avoid C calls on a deliberately misaligned stack.
resource_budget: No heap; validation-only stack frames removed from ordinary images when unreferenced.

title: ARM timer catch-up and rollover variants
requirement: ARM simulation shall exercise masked multi-period timer catch-up, an initial 32-bit counter rollover with unchanged reload modulus, and varied queue capacity and tick rate.
acceptance_criteria: Ticks remain unchanged while masked then catch up within a counter deadline; near-wrap and faster-tick presets pass finite message and semaphore workloads.
verification: QEMU normal, near-wrap and faster-tick runs with retained logs.
configuration: CMSDK timer initial value configurable separately from full 32-bit reload; stress follows configured tick rate.
resource_budget: No dynamic firmware storage; variant queue capacity fixed at compilation.

title: Reproducible IPC models and discriminating ARM witnesses
requirement: IPC verification shall include reproducible reference-state campaigns, exhaustive three-waiter ordering variants, and ARM witnesses that distinguish first-handler catch-up and live-window interruption.
acceptance_criteria: Four seeds cover 600000 operations at three capacities;1296 waiter campaigns cover priorities, ties, expiry and changes; ARM records live-window PC, first elapsed count, preload and extended-time continuity.
verification: Host CTest and actual ARM QEMU campaigns with retained logs.
configuration: Fixed-capacity host oracles; optional ARM stress witness hooks default off outside stress presets.
resource_budget: No heap or TCB growth in ordinary firmware; stress-only observer state documented.

title: Optional host memory analysis and fail-closed symbol audits
requirement: Native C++ host fixtures shall support optional ASan/UBSan and separate Valgrind Memcheck execution; firmware name audits shall reject empty or stripped symbol evidence and bound compiler/audit subprocesses.
acceptance_criteria: Separate presets instrument native C++ or add finite Memcheck variants; both reject firmware configurations; stripped compiler fixture and symbol-presence self-tests pass; tool subprocess failures remain failures.
verification: Actual sanitizer/Memcheck CTest and ARM/RV32 compiler contracts.
configuration: CMake native checks and XDoc C# bounded executor; no custom Python tooling.
resource_budget: No target heap, RAM fields or runtime instrumentation; host model results do not qualify firmware.

title: Retained evidence and controlled analyzer detection gates
requirement: Engineering checkpoints shall retain explicitly selected passing logs, manifests and audited unstripped images with bounded hash verification; controlled invalid-memory probes shall demonstrate specific analyzer rejection.
acceptance_criteria: Native C# collector rejects traversal, links, overwrite, size/count excess and changed/unlisted/duplicate inputs; round-trip/tamper self-tests pass; ASan, UBSan and Memcheck probes require intended diagnostic plus failure.
verification: Native evidence self-tests, actual controlled-failure gates and final package verification.
configuration: XDoc C# Native AOT collector with bounded inputs; probe output captured by shared bounded executor.
resource_budget: No firmware services or RAM; intentionally invalid host probe excluded from ordinary builds.

title: Optional portable DMA staging and quarantine implementation
requirement: An optional DMA module shall serialize thread callers over one active transfer per channel using boot-reserved exclusive staging and explicit BSP address/cache/quiescence contracts, without retaining application-buffer pointers.
acceptance_criteria: DMA defaults off and adds no kernel fields; TX copies before launch; RX copies only after quiescent completion; stale tickets cannot release new transfers; uncertain abort quarantines until positive stop proof; host ownership tests pass.
